learning_outcomes.text: classify and categorize different development processes.
create a continuous development model along the process chain.
understand the necessity of a methodical approach to operate the process chain (VR -CAO- CAD-CAE-CAT-3dPrint).
recognize and analyze data diversity/data detailing.
organize and present the continuity of their development work. They learn important properties of digital development tools with their strengths and limitations.

syllabus_topics: From product idea to prototype of a series product
Digital methods of model creation (topology optimization, 3D scratching)
Property description through simulation, virtual and physical
Representation of the data process chain and its relationships using a mini-product development (3D-CAD / FEM)
Methods of Rapid Prototyping and Tooling
Organizational forms in companies (Simultaneous and Concurrent Engineering)
Engineering Data Management (EDM) systems and their archiving and documentation
Interface problems and the role of data logistics

assessment_methods.method: Project work with oral presentation (15 min) and written elaboration (5 - 25 pages)
